crossRefs.note: The priests consented that they should take no more money from the people, and not repair the damage to the house.
But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as…
Jesus sat down opposite the treasury, and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast…

translations.web: So the king commanded, and they made a chest, and set it outside at the gate of Yahweh’s house.
translations.bsb: At the king’s command a chest was made and placed outside, at the gate of the house of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And at the king's commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of the LORD.
translations.asv: So the king commanded, and they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of Jehovah.
